result.disconnectBehavior: Dispose this connection and publicly close its exact worker-created scope-probe UI process. The qualification controller must independently verify its exit through the original retained handle.

capabilities.name: discover
capabilities.reason: Installed V21 Openness; discovery depends on current Windows session and Openness access.

capabilities.name: attach
capabilities.reason: Requires an accessible V21 process and Openness authorization; attaches without opening or closing its projects.

capabilities.name: project_inventory
capabilities.reason: Bounded offline device/address and block inventory including exposed software/safety units and generated system groups. Detailed inspection is provided by separate tools.

capabilities.name: project_index
capabilities.reason: Bounded immutable metadata snapshots with authenticated pagination; external edits require explicit metadata verification, not a whole-project or logic revision.

capabilities.name: project_model
capabilities.reason: Read-only versioned native hierarchy, bounded cached child/search queries, exact snapshot references, separately observed inspection/relationship evidence and portable JSON exports. Metadata does not certify content; hardware composition does not prove physical topology.

capabilities.name: block_read
capabilities.reason: Native SimaticML XML export for eligible blocks; protected, inconsistent and F-system blocks can reject export.

capabilities.name: xref_query
capabilities.reason: Native CrossReferenceService on the selected block or PLC; bounded result flattening with native locations.

capabilities.name: start
capabilities.reason: Explicitly starts a worker-owned TIA instance without UI; disposal requests connection release. Siemens closes the instance when no other Openness client remains.

capabilities.name: catalog_query
capabilities.reason: Queries the installed hardware catalog of the attached V21 instance; an open project is required.

capabilities.name: scratch_create
capabilities.reason: Only a worker-owned empty TIA instance can create a uniquely named scratch project, one catalog-verified CPU and fixed SCL fixtures.

capabilities.name: project_open
capabilities.reason: Existing .ap21 files can be opened in an empty worker-owned instance; no automatic upgrade.

capabilities.name: software_inspect
capabilities.reason: Tags/constants, types, software/safety units, block/DB interfaces and TO parameters via exposed services and native XML.

capabilities.name: hardware_inspect
capabilities.reason: Offline hardware attributes, configured address ranges, network and exposed channel metadata; coverage varies by module.

capabilities.name: static_analysis
capabilities.reason: Native cross-reference call graphs, readers/writers, I/O associations and change impact. Indirect access and unresolved instance propagation remain explicit gaps.

capabilities.name: recoverable_changes
capabilities.reason: Prepare/apply with preview hashes, conflict detection, recovery archive, persistent journal and compile results. Supported source/XML and typed engineering subsets only.

capabilities.name: library_management
capabilities.reason: Managed global/project libraries, exact native type/version inspection, native copies, constrained authoring/update operations and durable resource journals. HMI products and native target qualification remain separate prerequisites.

capabilities.name: safety_engineering
capabilities.reason: Exposed safety metadata/signatures and dedicated eligible F-block XML import. Protection is respected; safety acceptance/commissioning is outside this workflow.

capabilities.name: simulation_download
capabilities.reason: Offline memory-card generation for an independently verified owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 instance; no physical PLC download route.

capabilities.name: simulation_provision_scratch_credential
capabilities.reason: Existing generated scratch credential provisioning only for a ticket-bound owned local PLCSIM instance over isolated Softbus; runtime qualification is separate.

capabilities.name: runtime_values
capabilities.reason: Separate PLCSIM Advanced V8 adapter provides typed values and bounded test scenarios; installed runtime license and compatible CPU/program are required.

capabilities.name: physical_plc
capabilities.reason: No physical PLC runtime writes, forces, downloads or CPU state changes are exposed.

selectedCpu.selection: Installed standard CPU 1511-1 PN; newest available firmware across matching articles, with article number as deterministic tie-break.

runtimeUser.purpose: Generated password for one new isolated scratch CPU runtime user

scratchSecurity.scope: Only newly created CPUs in the current worker-owned scratch project

result.exportScope: Only the four fixed standard source fixtures; generated safety/system blocks are not exported.
attemptedCoverage: Fixed standard SCL FC, FB, instance DB and cyclic Main OB call

result.scopeReason: No qualified complete effective-object readback or exhaustive proof profile. SetScope and diagnostic findings cannot establish coverage.
No qualified complete effective-object readback or exhaustive proof profile. SetScope and diagnostic findings cannot establish coverage.

result.disconnectBehavior: Dispose only this Openness attachment; the user-owned TIA instance remains open.
